title: Shop voice reorder offer result
description: Structured result after asking the owner whether to place a restock order for items running low. No vendor is dialed as part of this call.

reorder_offer_completed.description: True when the yes/no reorder question was answered clearly.

owner_wants_to_order.description: True only when the owner explicitly said yes to placing an order.

items.description: Per-item order detail. Empty if the owner declined.

vendor_name.description: Spoken vendor name, saved or new. Omit if the owner did not name one.

vendor_goods.description: What the vendor sells, as the owner described it. Only set for a new vendor.

vendor_phone_e164.description: Only set if the owner stated the number. Never invented.

owner_notes.description: Optional free-text; must not contain financial advice or loan discussion.
